summary: Amrize Ltd filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on April 21, 2026. Shareholders approved all routine proposals including annual report, executive compensation (advisory), frequency of say-on-pay (annual), Swiss remuneration report, non-financial matters report, offsetting of losses, a special dividend of $0.44 per share, an ordinary dividend of up to $0.44 per share in installments, discharge of directors and management, and re-election of the board. The filing is a standard post-meeting report of shareholder votes. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is present. The special and ordinary dividends represent capital returns but are routine annual distributions. This is a routine current report of meeting results.
